response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates deep technical expertise across distributed systems, AI-driven tooling (MCP, agentic workflows), and high-throughput architectures (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby). His recent Staff role at re:cinq aligns closely with the job's focus on AI-native engineering and technical strategy, though his background leans more toward general distributed systems than AI infrastructure. His operational ownership, stakeholder coordination, and agile experience are strong, but his exposure to AI-native environments is limited compared to ideal candidates.
strengths: Strong distributed systems experience with high-throughput architectures (e.g., Dunnhumby’s micro-services handling millions of requests/sec)
Direct experience with AI-agent infrastructure and tooling (MCP, code generators) at a Staff level
Broad technical breadth across languages, domains, and roles, with a proven ability to lead technical strategy
concerns: Limited explicit experience with LLM/ML or AI products (only indirect exposure via AI-agent infrastructure)
No clear evidence of operating in a fully agentic code-production environment (baseline for this role)
Lacks operational leadership context (e.g., on-call incident response) in recent roles
